name: Consecrated Fanged Beast
desc:
Remnant Weed: Consecrated Fanged Beast

A predator that has mutated after feeding from greater lifeforms. It now wields the power of frenzied vines.

desc.text:
<color=#ffd780>Event Card</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Randomly</color> <color=#ffffff>Discard</color> <color=#ffffffa6>1 card from your Hand with the highest</color> <color=#ffffff>Current Elemental Dice Cost</color> <color=#ffffffa6>and create 1 Elemental Die of your active character's Element. (Only 1 such card can be played per Round)</color>

<color=#ffd780>Elemental Burst</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Deal 4</color> <color=#99ff88>Dendro DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>. If there are</color> <color=#ffffff>Bonecruncher's Energy Block</color> <color=#ffffffa6>in your Hand,</color> <color=#ffffff>Discard</color> <color=#ffffffa6>1 and prepare Skill:</color> <color=#ffffff>Sprouts of the Blighted Rot</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>

<color=#ffd780>Passive Skill</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>(Passive) When battle begins, create 2</color> <color=#ffffff>Bonecruncher's Energy Block</color> <color=#ffffffa6>and place them at the bottom of your Deck. You can play 1 extra</color> <color=#ffffff>Bonecruncher's Energy Block</color> <color=#ffffffa6>each Round.</color>

Applies Dendro and can trigger the following Elemental Reactions:
[ <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> + <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Bloom</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, creates a [ <color=#ffffff>Dendro Core</color> ] that greants +2 DMG to the next instance of Pyro or Electro DMG
[ <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> + <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Burning</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, creates a [ <color=#ffffff>Burning Flame</color> ] that will deal 1 Pyro DMG at the end of the Round (Takes effect once, max 2 stacks)
[ <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> + <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Quicken</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, creates a [ <color=#ffffff>Catalyzing Field</color> ] that grants +1 DMG to the next 2 instances of Dendro or Electro DMG

<color=#ece5d8>Physical DMG</color>
Physical DMG will not apply any Elements, nor can it engage in Elemental Reactions.
<color=#ece5d8>Discard</color>
Use Action Cards or Character Skill effects to Discard Action Cards from Hand or Deck.

A predator that has mutated after feeding from greater lifeforms.
Survival of the fittest is written in the law of nature. But pets and Consecrated Beasts are exceptions. Human beings' baits and the remains of immortal beings are essentially deliberate or unintentional traps. The price of coveting the gift of the strongest is much more painful than being locked in a cage.
